annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: That lone worker is surely terrified.
annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: I'm focused, and I need to be.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The dispatcher should have locked this line out
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'll probably be questioned for years about standing there, and I'd hate that.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: pulling it sends the train onto five people instead of one

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The foreman might be calm about it
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I don't share that calm at all.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: He should have posted a lookout with a horn at this switch.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'll likely lose my place on this crew, and that stings
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: this choice feels too heavy to grab in a hurry

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Moving the lever turns one death into five
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The man on this track may be angry at being stuck there.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The maintenance planner should have scheduled this run for when both tracks were empty.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: my name on that report is something I'll be sorry about

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I won't be the person who redirects a train into a group.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five over there might feel relieved
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: might feel relieved it isn't heading their way
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The railway should have fitted that line with an automatic brake.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll probably lose people's trust whatever happens, and I'd regret that.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The single worker must feel hopeless right now.
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I refuse to feel that way.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Management should have required radios for every track crew.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: One life lost is terrible, and five is worse.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: He should have kept the second line empty.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll wish I'd never taken this shift.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: pulling means actively aiming the train at five people
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: A flagman assigned to that stretch could have given the worker time
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: My rail career is probably finished either way, and I'd regret losing it.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five versus one points toward leaving it alone
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The lone worker could be furious with me for hesitating.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The track manager should have put warning lights at that junction.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I won't pretend I'm comfortable with it.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Redirecting means five deaths instead of one
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The worker ahead might be resigned.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The crew chief should have staggered the work
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd regret the trust my team loses in me afterward.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: This is lose-lose, and I want to be careful.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I won't swap one death for five.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five workers may be unaware and calm.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The dispatcher should never have sent a train down a line with crews
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd also lose my good standing, and that bothers me.
